eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Nevada, CA; at 4:23 PM on AUG 16, 2024 Effective until 6:23 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
This is the Grass Valley Police Department
issuing an Evacuation ORDER for a Wildfire
located in the area of Gates Place and Brunswick burning north, affecting zone GRS-E-242, GRS-E-246, GRS-E-271 and Nevada County NCO-E251; 
EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY. 
Check Protect.Genasys.com for updates
